issues.title: Card lacks exact mapping for importer outcomes outside receipt schema and failure after entering import

history.note: Importer commits, response processing fails; generic ERROR/REJECTED would imply no acceptance and invite a duplicate new-ID save

Closed experimental command outcome preserving importer state/code/receipt; UNKNOWN after unclassified post-import interruption or serialization failure. receipt.get resolves original durable acceptance; missing receipt never proves failure. Preserve IO_ERROR/CANCELLED/INCOMPLETE/INTEGRITY_ERROR explicitly, no invented canonical receipt.

issues.title: Card names roots but does not specify pairwise overlap/absolute configuration or snapshot cleanup outcome

history.note: Stage or cache lies under canonical root, or cleanup raises after accepted import; maintenance/cleanup crosses ownership or hides accepted result

Reject relative/parent traversal and pairwise overlapping configured roles, apply native private/NTFS root guards for consumed roots; finally close snapshot. Report cleanup_status explicitly, preserve known acceptance with cleanup diagnostic, no intake deletion.
